prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: fictional South African stationery catalogue POC product photograph. Create ONE photorealistic studio product cut-out, square 2000 x 2000 pixels, PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the product. No surface, no backdrop colour, no checkerboard painted into the image, no contact shadow, no cast shadow, no reflections on a floor. Natural shading on the product itself is allowed. Same studio setup throughout this set: large soft key light from upper left, gentle neutral fill from right, neutral white balance, realistic material detail and proportions, crisp focus throughout, front three-quarter camera view from 18 degrees above unless the subject description specifies otherwise. Centre the complete product/group with its longest dimension occupying 75 percent of the canvas and at least 12.5 percent clear margin, no clipping. Absolutely no people, hands, logos, branding, letters, words, numbers, pseudo-writing, watermarks, stamped markings or recognisable branded product designs. Products and packaging must be entirely unprinted; naturally numbered tools are deliberately unmarked. Generate entirely from this description; no web images or outside references. Subject: ONE generic school backpack of 25-litre capacity, base navy colour #1E2A4A, plain woven polyester with realistic fine weave, stitched seams and matte fabric. Two zipped compartments only: a large main compartment and a practical rectangular front compartment, each with simple black unmarked zipper pulls. Unbranded shoulder straps and a top carry loop. Upright, naturally filled to show real bag volume, front three-quarter view from 18 degrees above, showing front and a little right side. No diamond patches, badges, emblems, contrasting brand-shaped panels, text or ornamental logos. The entire backpack and its straps must be connected and anatomically plausible as sewn bag construction. All navy fabric remains dark navy rather than electric blue. Nothing inside or beside it.
